name: Ring of Lightning
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (small glass ring)

EFFECT

Range personal
Effect ring of lightning
Duration 1 round/2 levels
Saving Throw Reflex half (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a constantly spinning and rotating ring of lighting to encircle you. This does not interfere with you or others’ spellcasting or attacks. However, the ring grants you a resistance to electricity of 20 and any creature that begins their turn adjacent to you takes 10d6 electricity damage. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

Additionally, as a free action on your turn, you can unleash up to two lightning bolts that deal 5d6 electricity damage each in a 120-ft. Line. Each bolt may be sent in different directions. A successful Reflex save halves the damage from the bolt of lightning.
